array.string: export SUDO_ASKPASS="$HOME/.local/bin/sudo-askpass"; mkdir -p ~/.config/dotm/logs; L=~/.config/dotm/logs; W=~/.local/libexec/dotm-watchdog/watchdog.py; if [ -f ~/.config/dotm/watchdog.env ] && [ -x "$W" ]; then set -a; . ~/.config/dotm/watchdog.env; set +a; "$W" ~/.local/bin/dotm sync --quiet >>"$L"/sync.log 2>>"$L"/sync.err.log; else ~/.local/bin/dotm sync --quiet >>"$L"/sync.log 2>>"$L"/sync.err.log; fi
